snippet.title: Console Archives MARL JONG
snippet.description:
*The game includes only the Japanese version. Please note that all in-game text is in Japanese only.

"MARL JONG" was released by Nippon Ichi Software in 2003 for a 32-bit home console.
This is a game in which you go on an adventure while competing in "MARL JONG" matches with the people of Marl Kingdom.
With simple controls, gameplay progresses smoothly! Furthermore, you can enjoy heated battles using character-specific "Special Moves" and comeback-enabling “Cheat Techniques”.

Unrevealed episodes of Marl that were not told in the main story will also be disclosed...

The "Console Archives" series is developed with the concept of faithfully reproducing masterpieces released on various home game consoles, allowing players to easily enjoy them on the latest hardware.
The series is packed with convenient features, including customizable button layouts and screen settings, as well as the ability to save and load at any point.
Whether you played them back in the day or are experiencing them for the first time, please enjoy the masterpieces that shaped the history of console gaming!


©Nippon Ichi Software, Inc. / ©HAMSTER Corporation
